title: People are addicted
author: Saytron3030
selftext:
OK gotcha headline over. People are addicted to CREATING THINGS they always have been. It is what makes us innately human.

What I have noticed with this AI game Dev is now people actually feel like it's possible with all the constraints of the modern world. Time has always been a luxury and skills take 1000s of hours to gain. Now creation is at the tips of our fingers.

We should give a break to people making clones of other games, being creative is hard, they haven't had much practice.

We will all get better and I think more accessibility to Creation is a good thing.
